lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-lateral flank, with a primary cluster of approximately 35-40 visible nodes arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like pattern where spots act as vertex nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, showing a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a secondary constellation of smaller, high-intensity spots along its dorsal surface, though density decreases significantly toward the distal edge.
